change: Test runs disable QML transition animations; production keeps them unless the test environment variable is set
motivation: Qt 6.2 MainRouting teardown SIGSEGV: an icon color animation reloads an image with qmlEngine() == nullptr after the MainWindow context ends

mechanism.switch: BITCOIN_QML_TEST_NO_ANIMATIONS=1 (only consumed at AppMode construction; unset in production)
mechanism.exposure: AppMode.animationsEnabled (CONSTANT) -> Theme.animationsEnabled (writable, so individual cases can opt back in)
mechanism.gates: Every Behavior on ... and every Popup enter/exit Transition in qml/ is gated by Theme.animationsEnabled, combined with any pre-existing condition; CheckBox.animationsEnabled and Tooltip.motionEnabled default from the switch
mechanism.test_wiring: The QML, unit and integration test mains set the variable themselves before creating any engine, so direct invocations are also animation-free; CTest environments and both functional harnesses set it too. Cases that assert motion opt back in via Theme.animationsEnabled or the component property
mechanism.production_default: Animations enabled; no app behavior change when the variable is unset. Doc follows PR 1052's MotionPreference/motion-off precedent without adopting its full token system

regressions_found_and_fixed_during_revie.Theme_import: PaymentRequestModal.qml referenced Theme without importing ../controls; affected the receive integration group and Qt 6.10.2 qmltests. Added the import.
regressions_found_and_fixed_during_revie.animation_assertions: Two tests assert intermediate frames/animated visibility; they now opt in explicitly instead of silently losing coverage
regressions_found_and_fixed_during_revie.qt64_wallet_controller_flake: WalletQmlControllerTests::initializationIsSingleShotAcrossPendingSuccessFailureAndShutdown(ready) verified StrictMockNode counters at destruction before the default worker settled; it now QTRY-waits for the three counters, preserving the exact oracle. Full 6.4.2 suite then passed twice, 2877/2877, exit 0.

validation.full_qml_suites: Qt 6.2.4 twice, Qt 6.4.2 once, Qt 6.10.2 once: 861 passed, 0 failed, exit 0 each with transitions gated and the mains defaulting animations off
validation.units: Qt 6.2.4, 6.4.2 (twice) and 6.10.2 from the build root: exit 0, 2877/2877 each
validation.journeys: 15/15 on Qt 6.2.4 and 15/15 on Qt 6.10.2 with transitions gated
validation.qml_lint: 244 files, 0 warnings/errors per qt62/qt65 resource profile, all five negative probes pass

limitations: Qt 6.2 remains a deferred native-Qt attribution candidate; disabling animations removes the observed trigger rather than proving the upstream root cause. The fixture-delegate destruction-receipt teardown proposal remains unimplemented. Animation-dependent behavior is still exercised by the opting-in cases.
speed: Animation removal buys reliability, not wall time: the full QML suite is dominated by component construction and stays near 290 s. Immediate property values remove teardown callbacks and animation-dependent waits.
